home.title: Honor the memory of those who matter
home.lead: Testimona helps you create a lasting memorial page: testimonials, biography, photos and tribute donations, in a thoughtful space shared with your loved ones.
home.featureTestimonialsDesc: Collect memories from loved ones, in French or English.
home.featureBiographyDesc: Tell the person's story, chapter by chapter.
home.featureDonationsDesc: Let visitors make a tribute donation via Stripe.
